about.title: About the company
about.subtitle: Industrial construction, installation, and technical diagnostics. Odesa and regions of Ukraine.
about.heritageTitle: A trust’s discipline, a company’s accountability
about.heritage: The company has operated since 1997. We were founded on the legacy of the Chornomorpromsantekhmontazh trust and kept its industrial culture: schedule discipline, engineering precision, respect for safety codes. Clients in Odesa and across Ukraine need a contractor they can entrust with a boiler, a crane, a pipeline, and a weld — that is the work we have done for decades.
about.mission: To build and maintain industrial infrastructure so the client receives a verified result, not a promise: from the drawing to the laboratory protocol.

precision.title: Precision
precision.text: Calculation, tolerance, protocol. Work is complete when it is evidenced.
